items.title: 66086_Zilner T. Randolph oral history interview
items.q: I think I joined Woody Herman right about '38... What were some of the arrangements you did for Woody's band?

ctx.x: See, and they cut my band. Well, they cut me -- like, tonight -- like, today, the next night I got a letter from -- yes -- no, a telegram from Woody Herman, asking me to join them. So that was good.
